chunks: That Allah, Blessed and Exalted, returned the sun for Yūshaʿ ibn Nūn, the waṣī of Mūsā عليه السلام, so that he performed the salat (prayer) that had passed him by within its proper time.

key_terms.رُوِيَ: it has been narrated or reported
key_terms.وَصِيِّ مُوسَى: the successor or legatee of Mūsā

ai.seo_question: Did Allah return the sun for Yūshaʿ ibn Nūn so he could perform salat (prayer) on time?
ai.summary: This report states that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, returned the sun for Yūshaʿ ibn Nūn, the successor of Mūsā عليه السلام, so that he could perform the missed salat (prayer) in its proper time. The narration highlights a miraculous divine act connected to a righteous servant and the importance of salat (prayer).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, returned the sun for Yusha' ibn Nun (Joshua), the successor of Musa (as), so that he could perform the prayer that he had missed within its proper time."
